  • 日本語名: DARK †失楽の姉妹人形†
  • 英語名: DARK †Shitsuraku no Shimai Ningyou†

あらすじ

Medieval kingdoms world. The struggle between humans and other races ends with the victory of human beings with the other races getting oppressed. Main character is a dark elf who makes a fortune in the slave trade by supplying humans with peculiar species. He swears revenge on the elf race who destroyed his homeland. This time he makes elf girls his slaves and humiliates them for the sins of their race. But it’s only a mistake…

  • 英語名: Kuruwa no Hana Yoru ni Saku Kimi no Omoi Egakishi

あらすじ

The main character is an Edo era painter. Having once nearly died from starvation, he now barely makes ends meet by making portraits of girls who have just been sold into prostitution. Stuck between an abusive employer and memories of failing to save any of his family members, he is one day brought a gentle girl he does not want to separate with.

别名

  • 聖痕～牙と贄と狂喜の館～

あらすじ

Roan is a young man with amnesia. He lives quietly in the old castle in the eastern Romania with his maids. The older maid Rachel substitutes mother to him, and the younger Cartier adds vivid colors to the life.

Such peaceful life lasts till tortured mummies of parents are found in the basement. The gears of fate start rolling like crazy…
